Monty runs Python written by a model with no container, VM or sandboxing service in the loop. Creating a sandbox and running ten commands in it takes 5 ms (Docker: 900 ms, a sandboxing service: 1900 ms), a paused interpreter serialises to bytes you can resume later, and memory, time and recursion limits are enforced by the VM itself. What is Monty? Monty is a minimal Python interpreter that executes a useful subset of Python through a custom bytecode virtual machine. Unlike CPython, Monty does not provide direct access to the host environment—all filesystem, network, and environment operations are suspended and handed back to the host application for controlled execution.
